The training shall N4215826QN037 Page 5 of 43 be instructor led by instructor(s) with certification in both Root Cause Analysis and Human Factor Analysis. The contractor must provide all necessary and associated instructors, training material and all modules on a web- based platform. The curriculum shall encompass causal analysis system to target root causes and eliminate conjecture upon establishment of key facts in the investigative process. The contractor is required to have the training facilitated by an instructor with experience developing programs for complex investigations that involve human error scenarios. The goal is that each participant will add to their personal development by applying new additional tools of methodology

ective actions with limited learning. Each Workshop session shall be administered to up to 30 NNSY personnel who oversee departments that investigate incidents and mishaps. Pre-work should be accomplished to allow a Senior Manager to understand the most relevant root causes of negative performance in their work area. Performance goals and strategic plans should be discussed during class with the instructor for following up in future sessions. 2. The development of HFACS was prompted by increasing problems with human performance. The current state of NNSY requires the application of RC and HFAC methodologies in support of process improvement. When NNSY encounters mishaps, near miss

documented to communicate lessons learned and derive mitigating actions going forward. This is accomplished through Team Learning Sessions, with the expectation that the session be performed immediately following an incident and/or accident. NNSY is currently experiencing a challenge in solving problems and investigating incidents involving human error. The timeliness of the completion of TLS Reports has also presented a challenge. To address the concerns, NNSY requires Apollo Root Cause Analysis (ARCA) training supplemented by HFACS training. 1.2 Objective/Scope: The objective of this task is to purchase a 3-year (Base +2 option years) of Root Cause Analysis (RCA) training utilized in the Human Factor Analysis and Classification System (HFACS) training. The overall training will enhance organizational capability to investigate, analyze, and expose root causes including human influences in operational investigations of incidents and accidents to improve operational performance and safety. The training will help safety professionals reduce the accident rate through systematic, data-driven investigative strategies and objective evaluation of mitigation methods. The desired end state is to have participants be equipped with efficient and effective knowledge for i

TLS Administration personnel, which encompasses in-person and virtual communication to provide mentoring and support. This training will help the Administrators perform independent reviews of causal analysis through the lens of HFACS, when providing feedback on final reports. Materials submitted for analysis ignitable liquids include debris samples taken from a fire scene, clothing taken from suspects or victims, or any other solid sample where it is desired to determine whether or not there are ignitable liquids associated with it. Such samples are submitted to the Laboratory in sealed nylon bags. Kombination von mindestens 150 m/min bei 1.200 × 600 dpi nicht auf ein einzelnes marktverfügbares System beschränkt ist. Insoweit stehen mehrere Systeme zur Verfügung, die die geforderten Leistungsparameter erfüllen. Auch an der Anforderung eines nachträglichen Speed-Upgrades vor Ort ohne Austausch des Drucksystems wird festgehalten. Diese Anforderung dient der langfristigen Zukunftsfähigkeit und Erweiterbarkeit der Investition. Eine spätere Steigerung der Produktionsleistung soll möglichst durch ein Upgrade des vorhandenen Systems und nicht durch einen vollständigen Maschinentausch erfolgen können. Damit sollen insbesondere die langfristige wirtschaftliche Nutzung, die Erweiterbarkeit des Systems sowie die Vermeidung zusätzlicher Investitions- und Umrüstungsaufwendungen sichergestellt werden. Die vorgeschlagene Absenkung auf 150 m/min bei 600 × 450 dpi sowie eine Änderung der Anforderungen an das nachträgliche Speed-Upgrade werden daher nicht vorgenommen. Die Anforderungen der Vergabeunterlagen bleiben unverändert bestehen. « lfd. Market research indicates that no other solution fulfills these specific requirements without significant impacts on schedule, costs, and operations. Therefore, Crestron remains the only provider capable of meeting the technical and compatibility needs for this upgrade. 2. What is the impact to the government if another vendor/brand is used? Include any dollar, schedule, or compatibility impacts if possible. Utilizing a different vendor or brand could result in significant schedule delays, as the government would need to evaluate, integrate, and train personnel on unfamiliar equipment. Previous experience indicates that such processes can considerably slow project progress. Additionally, switching to an alternative brand may introduce compatibility issues with the existing Crestron-based infrastructure, necessitating further technical adjustments, extended testing, and new approval procedures before the system can operate correctly. These challenges are likely to increase costs, compromise reliability, and disrupt operational continuity, making alternative brands both time-consuming and financially burdensome for the government.
